leadText:
Hello! My Future! (Korean: 안녕! 나의 미래! Annyeong! Na-ui Mirae!) is the third ending theme for the Korean dub of Pokémon the Series: XY. It debuted in XY049, replacing Happy Ending. It uses the same animation from the corresponding Japanese ending theme, DreamDream.

The full version of this song was used as an insert song for the Korean dub of XY064, XY080, XY090, XY091, XY101 , XY105, and XY109.
plainText:
Hello! My Future! (Korean: 안녕! 나의 미래! Annyeong! Na-ui Mirae!) is the third ending theme for the Korean dub of Pokémon the Series: XY. It debuted in XY049, replacing Happy Ending. It uses the same animation from the corresponding Japanese ending theme, DreamDream.

The full version of this song was used as an insert song for the Korean dub of XY064, XY080, XY090, XY091, XY101 , XY105, and XY109.

==Ending animation==
Serena is seen doing several different Pokémon Performances with and , each time with different clothes and styles in her performance. At the end of her final performance she bows her head and smiles, and then we see her, Fennekin, and Pancham all asleep, revealing Serena was dreaming about becoming a Pokémon Performer.
